{"data":{"id":"1102967","key":"RCS-14740","fields":{"summary":"Queries Exporting with 0 results","description":"

Good morning,

We are having an intermittent issue with queries not exporting out of Secure. It is impacting all users and all queries. When trying to export to excel, the notification says 0 results when there are results when the query is ran. Attached is a sample screenshot of one that I’m having issues with today. I am trying to export the detail for a query in my library under the Testing folder called “Bucket Promotion - No Bucket”. I get zero results in the excel file and when I try to export to email, I’m getting a message saying the export failed.

Thanks,

Cathryn

Hi Cathryn,

I found what is causing the report to not pull all results. In the first set of display options there is a Field called ‘Trans’ and with the way the report is setup to show Trans in the drill down it is causing the report to not populate correctly, which means the drill down results are incorrect as well. Once you remove the 'Trans from the first set of Display options the report will give you accurate information.

I was hoping by getting this done it would have fixed the Export part, but it did not. I am still investigating that part and will let you know once I find out what is happening.

Thanks,

BJ Probert
Customer Support Engineer
